findings.title: FFmpeg Cannot Process Cloudinary URLs Directly
findings.description: generateAndUploadThumbnail() receives Cloudinary URL but ffmpeg cannot reliably process remote cloud URLs. Local file is already deleted by uploadFileToStorage.
findings.consequence: Thumbnail generation fails for all uploaded videos. Users see no thumbnails on MyLectures page.
findings.correction: Generate thumbnail BEFORE uploading to Cloudinary in the upload route, while req.file.path still exists. Remove thumbnail generation from processingService.js.

findings.title: Thumbnail Generation Happens After Local File Cleanup
findings.description: processLecture() runs asynchronously after uploadFileToStorage deletes the local temp file. Thumbnail generation has no local file to process.
findings.consequence: Double failure: no local file AND unreliable URL processing means zero successful thumbnail generations.
findings.correction: Move thumbnail generation to upload route before uploadFileToStorage is called, while req.file.path exists.

findings.title: Missing Error Handling for Thumbnail Upload Failure
findings.description: Silent failures return null with only console.warn. No database tracking or user notification when thumbnail generation fails.
findings.consequence: Users never know thumbnail generation failed. No retry mechanism or visibility into failures.
findings.correction: Add thumbnailGenerationStatus field to lecture document tracking success/failure state and error messages.
